_comment: High-impact US macro events that move the open. Times are US/Eastern on the RELEASE date. The guard blocks NEW ENTRIES around these; protective exits are never blocked. Update this file when the calendar is refreshed - it is read at every entry decision, so no restart is needed.

events.name: CPI (Oct)
events.note: m/m only (Oct-2025 shutdown gap). nowcast +0.24% headline / +0.21% core. Released 08:30 ET, one hour BEFORE the 09:30 open, so the reaction lands at the open - that is the trade this guard exists to prevent.

events.name: PPI (Oct)
events.note: Also feeds the Dec FOMC hike odds.

events.name: NFP (Nov)
events.note: First Friday of the month by convention - VERIFY against the official release calendar before relying on it.

events.name: FOMC decision
events.note: Mid-session release. Also sits inside the existing 14:00-16:00 kill zone, so this guard mainly adds the pre-release hour. Dec hike odds 76.8-78% after hot Oct NFP (+165k, 4.1% U).
